name: Punk Zine
summary: Photocopied black and white, cut-and-paste letters, typewriter text, tape and hand scrawl. It came from the punk scenes of London and New York and shows that anyone can make a page.

philosophy.core_thesis: Anyone can publish: make the page with scissors, glue and a copier, and show the seams on purpose.
design_principles: Set the page in black on off-white (#F1EEE4) with one spot colour (fluorescent pink #FF2E88 or yellow) on less than 10% of the surface.
Mix 3 to 5 letter styles in a headline, each letter cut as a block with a 2px to 4px offset and a 1° to 6° tilt.
Set body text in a typewriter face at 15px to 16px with uneven word spacing; underline or strike through words by hand.
Add strips of tape (80px to 160px long, 20% opacity grey) at the corners of images and boxes.
Photocopy every image: greyscale, contrast 150% to 200%, a visible grain at 10% to 20%.
Rotate boxes and images by -4° to 4° and overlap them by 8px to 40px.
Add hand-drawn marks (arrows, X, scribbles) in marker with a 3px to 5px stroke.
anti_patterns: Perfect, uniform type in one face

layout.grid_mechanics: No strict grid: a loose two-column base of 8px units; blocks are pasted at an angle and overlap by 8px to 40px.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 5% to 15% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 12, 24 and 48px and is broken on purpose.
layout.alignment_rules: Flush left with a ragged edge; blocks tilt by -4° to 4°; headlines may run off the edge.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles cut with scissors: a 0px radius, a 2px black border or no border, and a torn edge on images.

font_pairings.note: A typewriter display with a plain typewriter text face.
A broken display face for single words.
A marker-hand for notes and arrows.

typography.tracking: Display takes -0.02em to +0.04em, varied by word; body stays at 0.
hierarchy_rules: Use two weights for body: regular (400) and bold (700).
Use sizes 15, 24, 48 and 96px; mix them within one headline.
Set headlines in upper case, in mixed letter styles.
Mark emphasis by hand-drawn underline in the spot colour.

color.palette_structure: Black and off-white with one fluorescent spot colour.
color.contrast_rules: Toner on newsprint holds 16:1; pink marks and large type only, not body text.
color.surface_treatment: Flat photocopy: black ink, a paper grain at 8% opacity and a light edge-darkening on photos.
color.light_and_shadow: None; the page is a flat copy; depth comes from tape, overlap and torn edges.

materiality.surface_simulation: Photocopied paper, masking tape and marker pen.
materiality.border_rules: A 2px black line, drawn unevenly; boxes may have a dashed or torn edge.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur. Shadow offsets are 3px 3px 0 in black at most; no elevation.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Hand-drawn pictograms with a 3px marker stroke, round caps and uneven lines; arrows and X marks.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Photocopied photographs and hand-drawn doodles; ransom-note letters cut from magazines.

motion.transition_physics: Translation for screen: stepped, jerky moves in 2 to 3 frames; elements jump between tilt angles with no easing.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover tilts the element by 2° and swaps ink and paper; active state adds a spot-colour highlight.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels raw defiance, urgency and DIY freedom.

avoid_when: The brand needs trust, order or a corporate tone.
The audience needs fast, accessible reading of long text.
The product handles payments or health data.

modifiers.how: Straighten the type onto a 12-column grid and drop the tape and tilt; keep black and white.
Add layered textures and distressed type; keep the black and white base.
Replace the tape with 3px solid borders and hard shadows; keep the loud colour.

pack.why: A rough, marker-like line with uneven form that reads as a hand drawing.

ground.why: A zine is a photocopy: heavy toner grain, black blocks and a strip of tape.
